title: Overpriced reusable grocery bags but they do hold a lot
text: Overpriced reusable grocery bags but they do hold a lot. There are four large reusable bags in this set, each with one small side pocket and one small front pocket. They open into a flat bottom and hold a lot of stuff as shown in my photo. I was able to get a pound of pasta, a club-sized box of Club crackers, and a back pillow into one bag. However, at the current price of $17.59 ($21.99 minus 20%) these come to $4.40 per bag which is about $3.41 more than the $.99 cents larger and more festive bags that can be purchased at Home Goods, TJX, or Marshalls.

product_metadata.title: YOOFAN Reusable Grocery Bags – Heavy Duty Shopping Bag for Groceries, Utility Multipurpose Tote, Shopping Cart Bag with Long Handles, Grey, 4 Pack
features: Reusable Grocery Bag - YOOFAN reusable grocery bags are designed to replace disposable plastic bags. These bags are made of polypropylene PP material which is durable and easy to clean. It measures 14.3" * 9" * 13.8", has a capacity of 7 gallons, and can carry a maximum weight of over 30 pounds. They are almost up to your daily shopping needs.

Multifunctional Tote - YOOFAN reusable grocery bag is self-standing and has a long handle, making it ideal as a shopping bag or a shopping cart bag. Apart from that, it is also suitable for other daily use, such as kitchen, utility room, beach, pool, gym, office, camping, car, etc.

Functional – The shopping bag has two small outside pockets, which can store some small items like mobile phones, keys, etc. These reusable grocery bags are collapsible and you can fold them up to save space when you don't need them.
Convenient - They are water resistant and washable. After washing them, they can be hung upside down to dry or wiped dry and can be used immediately.

Strong & Durable - YOOFAN reusable grocery bags are made of PP woven fabric and sewn with strong stitches. They are self-standing and have a long service life. They are a perfect substitute for disposable plastic bags, so as not to waste resources and damage the environment.
